Remark
[limitations on nonnegative Ricci curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0034 1. ch10:10.8\group Tensor maximum principles

Nonnegative Ricci and sectional curvature are not preserved by Ricci flow on arbitrary closed manifolds in dimensions at least four; the tensor principle requires its null-eigenvector hypothesis.
